# UKISH Mattress

UKISH Mattress is a mattress brand and manufacturer in Kazakhstan. The website helps customers browse orthopedic, premium, children's, and basic mattress collections, compare sizes and prices, and submit an order request.

## Primary URLs

- Website: https://matras-ukish.kz/
- Catalog: https://matras-ukish.kz/catalog
- Sitemap: https://matras-ukish.kz/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://matras-ukish.kz/robots.txt
- Product API: https://api.matras-ukish.kz/api/products

## Important Pages

- Home page: product highlights, manufacturing benefits, delivery, consultation form, customer reviews.
- Catalog: filterable mattress catalog with live data from the Strapi API.
- Product pages: static SEO-friendly pages at `/product/{slug}` with live client-side refresh from Strapi.
- Cart and checkout: customer order flow; these pages are intentionally not indexed.

## Products

The current catalog includes Diamond King, Diamond Prime, Smart, Kids Comfort, Classic Sleep2, and Ortho Hard. Product data is managed in Strapi and exposed through the public API.
